title: Discovery of Cinchona as Antimalarial, Viceroyalty of Peru, Circa 1630
version: Emerging Infectious Diseases, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

passages.quote: Chief Leiva revealed the secret of Cinchona as a febrifuge to a Jesuit missionary and, in turn, shared that information with the Corregidor Juan López Cañizares around 1630.
